title: Decide what the evidence actually supports
description: Select a finding, record the available proof, and set remediation state. Closure requires a complete chain and a passed retest.

evidence.label: Authorization record
evidence.detail: Signed scope, plan version, exercise ID, target, and time window.

evidence.label: Execution record
evidence.detail: Sanitized action ID, source, target, timestamp, and observed result.

evidence.label: Control record
evidence.detail: Prevention, telemetry, analytic, alert, or case evidence linked to the exercise ID.

evidence.label: Response record
evidence.detail: Owner, investigation decision, containment action, timing, and recovery result.

evidence.label: Deployment artifact
evidence.detail: Changed code, policy, rule, or runbook version with an accountable owner.

evidence.label: Retest record
evidence.detail: The same bounded hypothesis, changed control version, expected result, and observed result.

remediationStates.label: No remediation owner
remediationStates.detail: The gap is evidenced but no accountable treatment decision exists.

remediationStates.label: Change proposed
remediationStates.detail: An owner and plan exist, but the changed control is not deployed.

remediationStates.label: Change deployed
remediationStates.detail: The control changed, but the original hypothesis has not been replayed.

remediationStates.label: Retest failed
remediationStates.detail: The same bounded hypothesis still produces the unacceptable outcome.

remediationStates.label: Retest passed
remediationStates.detail: The same bounded hypothesis produced the expected control and response evidence.

findings.label: Expected telemetry is absent
findings.hypothesis: A bounded identity event should reach the analytics pipeline with the exercise ID.
findings.retestExpectation: The replay emits the required fields and reaches the governed destination.

findings.label: Alert fires but is not owned
findings.hypothesis: A high-confidence test alert should create a case and receive an analyst decision inside 15 minutes.
findings.retestExpectation: The replay links alert, case, owner, decision, and timestamps inside the objective.

findings.label: Containment has excessive impact
findings.hypothesis: Responders should isolate the test workload without disrupting its shared dependencies.
findings.retestExpectation: The replay contains only the named workload and preserves dependency health.
